facts.fact: Winter Village’s published 2026/27 season covers 28 October 2026–28 February 2027; Holiday Shops continue through 3 January 2027. This supports a 31 December seasonal stop rather than an invented public-midnight concert.

facts.fact: Skating admission and rentals are different products. The page offers reserved skating tickets and lists rental charges separately; free admission does not make an equipment-rental package free.

notes: Only actual 2026/27 season, booking and access/product distinctions used. Numerical rentals, upsells and a guaranteed midnight celebration are not inferred. Holiday shops/skating are a different plan from entering Times Square pens.
